what: one whole number that rolls up digit by digit like a mechanical counter, with its label
use_when: a large count where the rolling itself carries the weight: a total, a sum, a price
avoid_when: a percent of a whole (share), a before and after (change) or one of several numbers (bars)
rules: an "odometer" scene takes a whole number (zero or more, never a fraction): every digit rolls from 0 to its own, so even a zero spins a full turn;
the number is grouped the Georgian way, with a space between thousands (6 400), and a short "prefix" or "suffix" may stand beside it.
